{"success": true, "data": {"stdout": "#!/bin/bash
set -e

source /root/miniconda3/etc/profile.d/conda.sh && conda activate base
cd /root/recovery_aware_struct_prune

export CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0
export HF_HOME=/root/autodl-tmp/.hf_cache
export HF_HUB_OFFLINE=1

PYTHON=/root/miniconda3/bin/python
MODEL=/root/autodl-tmp/DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-7B
OUT_BASE=/root/autodl-tmp/recovery_aware_struct_prune

for ALPHA in 0.25 0.5 1.0 2.0; do
    PRUNED_DIR="${OUT_BASE}/pruned_rasp_alpha_${ALPHA}"
    EVAL_JSON="results/eval_pruned_alpha_${ALPHA}_westb.json"

    echo "========== ALPHA=${ALPHA} START at $(date) =========="

    # Prune
    if [ -f "${PRUNED_DIR}/config.json" ]; then
        echo "PRUNE_SKIP alpha=${ALPHA} (already exists)"
    else
        echo "PRUNE_START alpha=${ALPHA} at $(date)"
        $PYTHON src/prune.py \
            --model_path $MODEL \
            --importance_path results/importance_scores.pt \
            --cka_path results/cka_scores.pt \
            --mode rasp \
            --output_path $PRUNED_DIR \
            --sparsity 0.2 \
            --alpha $ALPHA \
            --seed 42
        echo "PRUNE_DONE alpha=${ALPHA} at $(date)"
    fi

    # Eval
    if [ -f "${EVAL_JSON}" ]; then
        echo "EVAL_SKIP alpha=${ALPHA} (already exists)"
    else
        echo "EVAL_START alpha=${ALPHA} at $(date)"
        $PYTHON -u src/eval_gsm8k.py \
            --model_path $PRUNED_DIR \
            --max_samples 100 \
            --max_new_tokens 4096 \
            --seed 42 \
            --output_path $EVAL_JSON
        echo "EVAL_DONE alpha=${ALPHA} at $(date)"
    fi

    # Clean up pruned model to save disk (keep alpha=1.0)
    if [ "$ALPHA" != "1.0" ]; then
        rm -rf "${PRUNED_DIR}/"
        echo "CLEANED alpha=${ALPHA}"
    fi
done

echo "===== ALL_DONE at $(date) ====="
